business_problem: The AFL is on a mission to celebrate ‘footy in every home’. That footy could be playing, supporting, coaching, umpiring, or even just volunteering down at the local club.
solution_summary: 1. Work smarter and faster to increase grassroots participation. Youth participation acts as a flywheel in the AFL, helping to grow the game and create lifelong fans. To take advantage of this, the AFL wanted to work more effectively with schools and community organisations to increase participation at the grassroots. Data on grassroots programs was previously siloed in emails and spreadsheets. It was difficult to track participation and know what initiatives were working and which weren’t. To solve this challenge, the AFL connected all its data on Salesforce for better, faster decision-making. Sales Cloud has helped by replacing emails and spreadsheets and bringing all school-based game development activities and data onto one platform. The game development team can now centrally record teacher interest in running school programs and follow up to offer support.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores account, opportunity, and workflow data teams use to connect grassroots, membership, and fan data for personalized engagement.

solution_components.name: Marketing Cloud
solution_components.role: Orchestrates personalized campaigns and outreach that support how teams connect grassroots, membership, and fan data for personalized engagement.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Provides dashboards and analytics teams use while they connect grassroots, membership, and fan data for personalized engagement.

solution_components.name: MuleSoft
solution_components.role: Connects external systems and APIs required to connect grassroots, membership, and fan data for personalized engagement.

architecture_clues: The implementation uses retrieval-augmented generation to ground responses.
Dashboards provide real-time visibility into operations and performance.
MuleSoft is used to connect back-office or operational systems into the workflow.
evidence_quotes: The AFL is on a mission to celebrate ‘footy in every home’.
That footy could be playing, supporting, coaching, umpiring, or even just volunteering down at the local club.
To achieve this goal, the AFL needed to work smarter to increase participation at the grassroots and grow fan engagement.
It has turned to Salesforce to do exactly that and is now kicking goals using CRM + Data + AI + Trust.
data_flow: Operational data is captured in Salesforce workflows, analyzed in Tableau, and then fed back to teams making decisions about how to connect grassroots, membership, and fan data for personalized engagement.
